task: Match the quick-controls sheet's drag handle to Apple's actual sheet-grabber proportions -- both the grip and the flat strip it sits on were chunkier than real iOS

public/styles/responsive.css.summary: .quickPanelHandle height reduced 44px -> 24px (a short flat strip, not a tall bar reserving 44px of blank space for touch-target purposes -- the primary 44px open/close target is already the icon in the top bar). .quickPanelHandleGrip reduced from the textbook 36x5pt/0.4-opacity spec to 34x3px/0.32 opacity -- a flat CSS rectangle at the exact spec size read chunkier on the web than native iOS's subtler anti-aliased grabber, confirmed via the apple-hig-expert skill and the user's direct visual feedback. Hover/focus opacity bump reduced 0.7->0.55 to stay proportionate to the fainter resting opacity.

test/public/style.test.js.summary: Updated the handle-height and grip-size assertions to match the new 24px/34x3px values.
